body:
`keycloak: Handle missing keycloak resource as access denied`
PR #68951: Issue is completely resolved and verified.
Tested #68450 and it's working as expected.

`apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes==10.19.0rc1`

PR #69046: The changes in this PR i.e. the addition of `team_name` to the various metrics in the KubernetesExecutor have been validated via unit tests. However, if you want me to setup a StatsD backend for manual verification, kindly let me know. Note that the reviewer with write access was satisfied with passing unit tests. 

PR #68507: The changes introduced in this PR are non-functional. No manual testing is required.

Due to other commitments, I cannot promise that I can get it tested by the end of the voting process. If I am not able to get it done before 2026-07-05 16:00 UTC, I will inform you on this thread. However, I do believe the unit tests are sufficient in this case. The manual testing is an additional 'sanity' check just to be more confident.

I verified the Multi-Lang feature with real k8s provider RC setup and it worked well.
I marked the checkbox as well.

Thanks @shahar1 again!

Thank you everyone. Providers are released.

I invite everyone to help improve providers for the next release, a list of open issues can be found [here](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aarea%3Aproviders).
